exposure: fetal simple transposition of the great arteries (TGA)
outcome: cardiac geometry and function (ventricular hypertrophy, systolic/diastolic function parameters)
urgent balloon atrial septostomy (BAS) after birth
cohort: The study included 67 pregnant women delivering at term (54 with uncomplicated pregnancies and 13 with fetal simple TGA).
finding: Simple TGA fetuses and neonates exhibited significant cardiac remodeling and dysfunction compared to normal controls, and several fetal cardiac parameters showed high predictive value for an urgent balloon atrial septostomy after birth.
followup_time: within the first few hours after delivery
